inputs.text: They’re dressing this up as a response to violence, but the real agenda is making punishment of Palestinians more routine and politically useful. Ben-Gvir’s party introduced a default death sentence for Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis, and the deterrence argument looks like a convenient cover: even opponents say it may not stop attacks. What it can do is signal whose lives the system values, normalize harsher control, and hand a political victory to the far right. The official rationale is the sales pitch; the power shift is the point.
